name: Danilith Nokere Koerse
story: An early breakaway of four riders animated the race. The final rider was reeled in with 25 km remaining. Alec Segaert launched a solo attack at 14 km to go, building a 30-second lead, but got caught by the bunch in the final 200 meters. Jasper Philipsen won the race ahead of Jordi Meeus and Juan Sebastián Molano.
